crossRefs.note: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”
When the servant of the man of God had risen early, and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around…
Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.
Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples…
At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

They came to him, and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”

translations.web: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
translations.bsb: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!”
translations.kjv: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
translations.asv: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, Lord, save me.
